newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's hard-left leader to meet London financiers.
newsitem.headline: Italy's hard-left leader to meet London financiers.

text.p: Fausto Bertinotti, leader of Italy's hard-left Communist Refoundation party which ensures the government a parliamentary majority, will address bankers and financiers at a debate in London on Friday, the party said.
The debate, on "a Social Model for Europe," is scheduled for 0715 GMT at Ironmongers' Hall in the Barbican district, a party statement said.
Bertinotti is also due to meet Arthur Scargill, secretary of the Socialist Labour party, later on Friday, it added.
Bertinotti is a key player in Italy's debate over welfare reform, seen as vital if Italy is to make the first round of Europe's single currency.

He has threatened to block any attempt by the centre-left government to cut social spending. The government cannot secure a majority in the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) without Refoundation support.
